parties.respondent: Federation of NOIDA Residents Welfare Association and others

summary: Toll validity under Concession Agreement; BOOT/PPP model; 15-year delay in challenging toll collection; CAG verification of project cost recovery; Articles 13,14 struck down for violating Article 14; High Court's finding that project cost fully recovered; no procedural fairness in entity selection; Appeal allowed as CAG confirmed under-recovery; toll imposition permitted until full cost recovery.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; toll collection permitted until total project cost recovery as per Concession Agreement.
